dingdongji.configuration.glowBandEnabled: The glowing band overlay on the metal armor sets. Turn this off if the band renders black or invisible on your GPU.
dingdongji.configuration.createTemplateP: Pin Create Template in Smithing Tables

When enabled, the create template (and its mode variants) is pinned to the first slot of the template catalog in the Royal/Ember/Frost/Transcendence smithing tables. Turn off to keep it at its natural position.
dingdongji.configuration.flightAfterimag: When enabled, players flying over-speed in Transcendium Boots leave a purple afterimage trail.
tooltip.dingdongji.squat_generator: Squat to generate power, higher squat frequency yields more power, up to 120 kW
tooltip.dingdongji.pouch: Craft with leggings to add %s pocket slots
tooltip.dingdongji.ji_anvil.desc: Breaks the enchantment level cap and doubles XP cost. 10% chance to double enchantments, 20% chance to add a curse; cursed enchanted items cannot be enchanted further
tooltip.dingdongji.ji_set: Full Set: Increases mining speed and block interaction range. Lay an egg behind you the moment you sneak, press [%s] to toggle
tooltip.dingdongji.transcendium_set: Full Set: Ignore planetary gravity, magic, void, contact and explosion damage; enter degenerate state to phase-shift, press [%s] to toggle
tooltip.dingdongji.devour.desc: Devour: Kill mobs to increase weapon damage
tooltip.dingdongji.devour: Devour: Kill mobs to increase weapon damage, formula %s
tooltip.dingdongji.accumulate: Burst: Accumulates energy in inventory, +0.2 damage/sec, halved on attack
tooltip.dingdongji.create_template.desc: Versatile: Right-click in hand to open the Transcendence Smithing Table panel and perform all smithing operations on the go, current mode:
tooltip.dingdongji.pouch.swap: Use the pocket hotkey to swap items with the offhand
tooltip.dingdongji.pouch.clear: Empty the pockets before taking off the leggings
tooltip.dingdongji.pouch.detach: Crafting pocketed leggings alone separates the pouch from the leggings
tooltip.dingdongji.royal_set: Full Set: Continuously restores your health
tooltip.dingdongji.comfortable: Comfortable: Press [%s], or [hold %s] while holding it, to toggle; walk with greater ease
tooltip.dingdongji.ember_set: Full Set: Ignore fire damage; continuously regenerates health while in lava or fire
tooltip.dingdongji.lava_walker: Lava Walker: Press [%s], or [hold %s] while holding it, to toggle fire trail; Walk on lava by default
tooltip.dingdongji.glowing_vision: Adapt: Press [%s], or [hold %s] while holding it, to switch between highlighting hostiles and night vision; Ignore darkness, adapt to oxygen-free environments and liquid overlays
tooltip.dingdongji.neutron_barrier: Neutron Field: Press [%s], or [hold %s] while holding it, to toggle enemy repulsion; Destroys incoming projectiles
tooltip.dingdongji.frost_walk: Frost Stride: Press [%s], or [hold %s] while holding it, to toggle reduced friction on blocks, sneaking restores normal friction; Walk on powder snow by default, ignore block friction and slowdown
tooltip.dingdongji.spectral_set: Full Set: Press [%s] to leave a phantom in place that phases through all blocks and ignores collision; the phantom vanishes the moment it or you take damage
tooltip.dingdongji.spectral_phase: Phasing: While wearing the full set and in phantom state, press [%s], or [hold %s] while holding it, to toggle vertical phasing through all blocks; sneak to descend, jump to ascend
tooltip.dingdongji.paranoid: Paranoid: Increases armor and armor toughness based on existing enchantment levels
tooltip.dingdongji.meaningless: Meaningless: Disables all enchantments and converts them into armor and armor toughness
tooltip.dingdongji.stride_void_enhanced: Stride Void: Creative flight while worn, press [%s], or [hold %s] while holding it, to toggle overspeed flight; sprint-fly while airborne; Ignore fall damage, block slowdown and block friction; Walk on the void floor and on fluids
tooltip.dingdongji.jei.beacon_conversion: Throw the matching gold ingot onto the beacon and let an anvil fall onto it; conversion chance scales with pyramid layers (the ingot is always consumed, success or not)
When 4 consecutive layers of the same block are built bottom-up, placing the beacon converts it instantly
tooltip.dingdongji.heavy_gold_block: A highly compressed gold block, explosion-proof
tooltip.dingdongji.cursed_heavy_gold_blo: A highly compressed cursed gold block that curses its carrier; carry a stack and something "good" may happen
tooltip.dingdongji.enchanted_heavy_gold_: A highly compressed enchanted gold block that cleanses curses from its carrier
tooltip.dingdongji.anchored_beacon: The wither power within the beacon has been converted and released; its beam purifies creatures, weakens monsters and freezes time
tooltip.dingdongji.supercooled_frost_met: Extreme low temperatures have broken its mass-energy balance; injecting mass lets it transcend into Transcendium
May degrade into a Royal Steel Block after warming up
tooltip.dingdongji.ji_ingot: A gold-chicken alloy fused from gold and egg fluid; a chick's soul seems to dwell inside
tooltip.dingdongji.keji_block: A large block of gold-chicken alloy fused from gold and egg fluid; it seems to be watching you
